function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

**Upcoming Major Festival in the United States** | Festival | Dates | Location | Highlights | |----------|-------|----------|------------| | **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | **April 12–15, 2026** | Empire Polo Club, Indio, California | • Multi‑stage music lineup spanning rock, hip‑hop, indie, pop, and electronic
• Iconic art installations and immersive visual experiences
• Food & beverage vendors featuring local and international cuisine
• Fashion & pop‑culture collaborations | ### Quick Facts - **Ticket Types** - *General Admission* – $400–$600 (includes access to all stages, food, and merchandise) - *VIP* – $800–$1,200 (includes reserved seating, exclusive lounge access, and premium merch) - **How to Buy** - Official website: [coachella.com](https://www.coachella.com) - Ticket sales typically open 2–3 months before the event; keep an eye on the “Tickets” section for release dates. - **What to Expect** - A vibrant, festival‑style atmosphere with a mix of music, art, fashion, and culinary experiences. - A diverse lineup featuring both established headliners and emerging artists across multiple genres. - A strong emphasis on sustainability, with initiatives such as waste reduction, reusable cups, and carbon offset programs. - **Travel & Accommodation** - The festival takes place at the Empire Polo Club, a 1,000‑acre venue in the Coachella Valley. - Nearby cities (Indio, Palm Springs, La Quinta) offer a range of lodging options from hotels to vacation rentals. - Consider booking accommodations early, as the area fills up quickly during the festival weekend. - **Weather Forecast (Indio, CA – April 12–15)** - Average high: 78 °F (26 °C) - Average low: 55 °F (13 °C) - Chance of rain: <5 % - Ideal for outdoor activities; bring light layers for cooler evenings. --- **Why It’s Worth Checking Out** - **Cultural Impact** – Coachella has become a benchmark for music festivals worldwide, influencing trends in music, fashion, and art. - **Economic Boost** – The festival brings significant revenue to the local economy through tourism, hospitality, and retail. - **Community Engagement** – Local businesses often collaborate with the festival for sponsorships, pop‑ups, and community events. --- **Next Steps** 1. **Check Ticket Availability** – Visit the official site and sign up for email alerts to stay informed about ticket releases. 2. **Plan Your Trip** – Book flights and accommodation early; consider transportation options to the venue. 3. **Prepare Essentials** – Pack comfortable clothing, sunscreen, a reusable water bottle, and a small backpack for day‑time essentials. Enjoy the experience!
